svg.title: What happened and why: from friction to rationale
svg.desc: Three steps. Friction detected: an undo storm in a CAD tool, Undo pressed three times. Utility for rationale: a prompt beside the selected part asks the designer to refine the next step, Wrong Physics or Aesthetic Mismatch. Dual-purpose value: the micro-episode serves UX, to diagnose friction, and ML, as a reward signal.
